This charter is a set of infographics, one service per page, rather than the ARTA
table the other offices use. Each page carries CLASSIFICATION, TYPE OF TRANSACTION
and WHO MAY AVAIL across the top, then three columns headed STEPS, CLIENT and
AGENCY ACTION, with PERSON RESPONSIBLE inside the agency column and a single
PROCESSING TIME for the whole service at the foot.

No page states a fee amount. Every page closes with the same line:

> Amount of fees and taxes to be paid in the Tax Order of Payment issued by the CTO
> with reference to the City Ordinance No. 13-2007.

Some pages add: *(Please refer to the table of tax rates from pages 1-11, posted in
every lane.)* The certified true copy and certification of business record pages
point to page 12 of that table instead, and the tricycle operators' permit page
points to the list of fees posted in the TOP lane.

Page 14 of the PDF carries no rasterized body and yielded no image; pages 1 to 13
below are the whole of the readable content.

## Page 1. Face-to-Face Application for Renewal of Business Permit | Lanes 1, 3-7

CLASSIFICATION: SIMPLE
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: GOVERNMENT TO CLIENT
WHO MAY AVAIL: APPLICANT FOR RENEWAL OF BUSINESS PERMIT

**1 SUBMIT.** Client: Submit the required documents to any of the designated lanes
from 1, 3 to 7. Requirements:

1. 1 original and 1 photocopy of Proof of Income (latest income statement from the
   Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) or Audited Financial Statement)
2. 1 original copy of Market Clearance for Market Stall Holders. The market
   clearance shall be returned to the applicant upon release of the business permit.
3. 1 original and 1 photocopy of Cert. of Authority or Valid Provisional Cert. of
   Authority for Head Office of Pawnshop and Money Service Business (JMC No. 1
   Series of 2019).
4. 1 original and 1 photocopy of BSP Letter on the Issuance of Code for Pawnshops
   Offices and Money Service Business other than Head Office.

*The original documents shall be returned to the applicant upon verification.*

Agency action: If application is deemed eligible, the Action Officer encodes the
pertinent data. Electronically submits to the BPLO for approval. CTO Assessor will
electronically assess the taxes and fees. BPLO Staff prints the final version of the
application form and Tax Order of Payment (TOP), and release these to the applicant
together with the feedback form. Note: If application is deemed ineligible, proper
documentation of findings will be given to the applicant.

PERSON RESPONSIBLE: LANE 1 | PRIORITY LANE Carlos A. Banton, Admin. Aide VI.
LANE 3 | BULK LANE Amelia A. Arevalo, Admin. Assistant I. LANE 4 | EXPRESS LANE
Joanelli E. Alejo, Admin. Assistant V. LANE 6 | EXPRESS LANE Kristine M. Torres,
Superv. Admin. Officer. LANE 7 | BULK LANE Josefina B. Moratin, Admin. Assistant VI.

**2 PAY.** Client: Proceed to the City Treasurer's Office to pay the computed taxes
and fees with reference to the issued Tax Order of Payment (TOP) provided in hard
copy, text, or email. You may also pay thru the following: GCash, Paymaya,
Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP), Land Bank of the Philippines (LBP),
Mastercard, Visa.

Agency action: 2.1 CTO Collector receives payment, prepares, and issues an Official
Receipt. 2.2 Instructs the applicant to proceed to Business Center Lane 9
(Releasing) to claim the business permit.

PERSON RESPONSIBLE: CTO Collector/s, Land Bank or DBP Staffs, GCash or Paymaya.

**3 CLAIM.** Client: Proceed to BPLO Releasing Area (Lane 9) and submit the duly
accomplished feedback form.

Agency action: BPLO Releasing Officer releases the Business Permit together with the
business plate/or sticker, and other clearances upon submission of the duly
accomplished Feedback Form.

PERSON RESPONSIBLE: LANE 9 | RELEASING Rebecca S. Añonuevo, Administrative Aide II.

PROCESSING TIME: 2 HOURS (MAXIMUM)

## Page 2. Face-to-Face Application for New Business Permit | Lane 2

CLASSIFICATION: SIMPLE
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: GOVERNMENT TO CLIENT
WHO MAY AVAIL: APPLICANT FOR NEW BUSINESS PERMIT

**1 SUBMIT.** Client: Submit the required documents to Lane 2. Requirements:

- One original duly filled-out Application Form (can be downloaded at
  legazpi.gov.ph/downloadable-forms/)
- 1 original copy of Sketch of Business Location
- 1 original and 1 photocopy of Certificate of Occupancy of the new space/building
  where business is located. *(The original copy shall be returned to the applicant
  after verification.)*
- 1 original and 1 photocopy of DTI/SEC/CDA Certificate. *(The original copy shall
  be returned to the applicant after verification.)*
- 1 original copy of Notarized Lease Contract (if leasing) / Letter of Authorization
  or Consent from the owner.

Other possible requirements:

- 1 original and 1 photocopy of Market Clearance for Market Stall Holders. *(The
  original copy shall be returned to the applicant after verification.)*

Agency action: as page 1, except the note reads: If application is deemed
ineligible, an applicant shall be given a notice of deficiency for compliance.

PERSON RESPONSIBLE: Jose J. Kallos, Jr., Admin. Aide III. Ma. Mae A. Codorniz,
Community Affairs Asst. II.

**2 PAY.** As page 1. Agency action 2.2 instructs the applicant to proceed to
Business Center Releasing Area (Lane 9). PERSON RESPONSIBLE: CTO Collector/s.

**3 CLAIM.** Client: Proceed to BPLO Releasing Area (Lane 9) and submits the duly
accomplished Feedback Form. Applicant shall receive the following: a. Locational
Clearance for the business; b. Mayor's Permit to operate the business.

Agency action: BPLO Releasing Officer releases the Business Permit together with the
business plate and/or sticker, and other clearances upon submission of the duly
accomplished Feedback Form.

PERSON RESPONSIBLE: LANE 9 | RELEASING Rebecca S. Añonuevo, Administrative Aide II.

PROCESSING TIME: 3 DAYS (MAXIMUM)

## Page 3. Online Application for New Business Permit | legazpi.gov.ph

CLASSIFICATION: SIMPLE
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: GOVERNMENT TO CLIENT
WHO MAY AVAIL: ONLINE APPLICANT FOR NEW BUSINESS PERMIT

The steps column shows SUBMIT, PAY and CLAIM bracketed together as a single step 1.

REQUIREMENTS. Note: The requirements for face-to-face application for new business
permit are the same as those for online new.

1.1 Client logs in to legazpi.gov.ph > Online Services > Services. 1.1.1 Click the
"new business application." 1.1.2 Specify the required information. 1.1.3 Fill out
the necessary details in the Unified Application Form (UAF). 1.1.4 Attach the
required documents in pdf or image file. 1.1.5 Review and verify the information
before submitting the application. 1.1.6 Upon approval of the application, a
notification regarding the tax order of payment (Assessment Record) will be sent to
the client via email or text message.

1.2 If the client opts to pay online, he or she should type in the Application
Number icon in the required space, which can be found in the Tax Order of Payment
(Assessment Record) sent to him/her. 1.2.1 Client selects payment options by
filling-in the needed information then proceed to click the "Pay Now" icon to select
the type of payment he or she chooses. Note: If the client opts to pay at the City
Treasurer's Office, he/she brings the Tax Order of Payment and pay the taxes and
fees.

1.3 Client sends the e-copy of the Feedback Form to legpermit2@gmail.com.

1.4 Submit the duly accomplished feedback form to Lane 9 Releasing Officer. *(if the
client prefers to claim the business permit at the BPLO)* Note: If a representative
will claim the Business Permit, Action Officer advises the client to let his/her
representative bring an Authorization Letter.

Agency action: 1.1 The Action Officer, upon receiving the complete requirements,
processes the application and sends the Tax Order of Payment (TOP)/Assessment Record
to the client thru email or text message. Note: If the application is deemed
ineligible, an applicant shall be given a notice of deficiency for compliance. 1.1.1
Action Officer sends an e-copy of a Feedback Form to the client to be accomplished
and submitted upon claiming the permit, and advises the client to pay thru Land Bank
of the Philippines (LBP) or DBP; GCash or Paymaya by following the instructions
provided on the city's website or pay at the City Treasurer's Office Payment area.
PERSON RESPONSIBLE: Mark L. Ranola, Licensing Inspector I. Rolando Abion, Jr.,
Admin. Officer I.

1.2 If the client paid online, Land Bank, DBP Staffs, GCash and Paymaya processes
the payment of the client. Note: If the client paid at the City Treasurer's Office,
Revenue Collection Officer processes the payment & issue the official receipt.
PERSON RESPONSIBLE: Land Bank or DBP Staffs, GCash or Paymaya; Revenue Collection
Officers - CTO.

1.3 Upon approval of the City Mayor's Office, the Action Officer sends an electronic
copy of the Business Permit to the client thru email after receiving the e-copy of
the duly accomplished Feedback Form, or advises him/her to proceed to BPLO Lane 9 to
claim the permit. PERSON RESPONSIBLE: Mark L. Rañola, Licensing Inspector I. Rolando
A. Abion, Jr., Admin. Officer I.

1.4 Action Officer in Lane 9 releases the Permit upon submision of the following: a.
Accomplished Customer's Feedback Form; b. Authorization Letter (if a representative
will claim the Mayor's Permit). PERSON RESPONSIBLE: Rebecca S. Añonuevo,
Administrative Aide II.

PROCESSING TIME: 3 DAYS (MAXIMUM)

## Page 7. Non Revenue Miscellaneous Permit

CLASSIFICATION: SIMPLE
TYPE OF TRANSACTION: GOVERNMENT TO CLIENT
WHO MAY AVAIL: APPLICANT FOR NON REVENUE MISCELLANEOUS PERMIT

**1 SUBMIT.** REQUIREMENT/S: 1 Original Letter Request and Endorsement from the City

**2 PAY.** Client: Client proceeds to the City Treasurer's Office to pay the
corresponding fees. Agency action: CTO Collector receives payment, prepares, and
issues an Official Receipt. PERSON RESPONSIBLE: Revenue Collection Officer - CTO.

Receipt to the Action Officer. 3.2 Client receives the original copy of the
document.

## Page 13. Feedback and Complaints Mechanism

HOW TO SEND FEEDBACK? Call or Text at 0915-872-7722. Email at
legpermit2@gmail.com. Accomplish the Feedback Form.

HOW FEEDBACKS ARE PROCESSED? 1. Clients are given the Feedback Form based on the
number of services they availed. 2. The assigned officer collect these forms at the
end of the transaction day and submitted to the Admin. Officer for recording. 3.
These are then collated per quarter and averaged as to the rating each client gave
per service availed. 4. The collated rating per quarter are then presented under the
Client Satisfaction Measurement (CSM) Report to get the office' rating. 5. This
report is then submitted to the City Human Resource Management Office (CHRMO) for
the collation of the agency's rating to be presented under the Harmonized CSM Report
which will be submitted to the Anti-Red Tape Authority.

HOW TO FILE A COMPLAINT? Complaints may be filed in writing or in person. You may
send a letter of complaint addressed to Ms. Asuncion C. Viñas, REA, REB, CGDH I -
BPLO or email it at legbplo@gmail.com. You may also call or text your complaint at
0915-872-7722.

HOW COMPLAINTS ARE PROCESSED? 1. In the Client Satisfaction Measurement (CSM) Survey
Form, the client (online/walk-in) can air their complaints/suggestions through
online or face to face. These complaint/s are assessed as to what action/s shall be
taken. 2. The Head of Office calls the attention of the concerned officer to verify
the veracity of the complaint. 3. When the complaint is checked as to its veracity,
the Head of Office will then act on the complaint. This can fall under the light
offense or grave offense depending on the commission of the act. The City Human
Resource Management Office, if called to assist, can apply their corresponding
sanction/s. 4. If the client asks for an appropriate action in the form of a letter,
he/she shall be given appropriate feedback as to the action/s applied to rectify the
act which need to be addressed.
